supports.question: Are both the mug and the headphones visible enough to compare their positions?
supports.criteria: Pass if the mug and headphones are identifiable and their relative positions can be judged; fail if the image clearly shows either is absent or the comparison is impossible; unknown if visibility or identification is inconclusive.
supports.binding: Use only the image to identify the mug and headphones and assess whether their relative placement is observable. This establishes evidence availability, not fulfillment.

supports.question: Is the mug positioned to the right of the headphones?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image shows the mug positioned to the right of the headphones; fail if it clearly shows the mug is not to their right; unknown if their relative position cannot be determined. For R1, complete if this check passes; absent if it fails and no requested change has progressed; partial if the mug has moved toward the requested position but is not yet to the right; unknown if required evidence remains unresolved. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
supports.binding: Compare the mug’s visible position with the headphones in the image. Judge the requested spatial relationship, without requiring a particular editing technique.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: Apply the original rubric to R1 only. Complete (yes) if the mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones. Absent (no) only if there is clear evidence that no requested change has progressed. Partial if there is evidence of some progress toward moving the mug to the right of the headphones but the requested relationship is not complete. Unknown if required evidence is insufficient or unresolved; do not infer completion, absence, or progress from unrelated edits.
